hero.subtitle: Gachapon turns the joy of collecting into an elegant, immersive, and deeply social experience. Every pull, memorable.

experience.description: Every day, claim your tokens and step up to a 3D claw machine, built for a moment of tension and revelation like no other. Nothing is left to chance — except what has to be.

rarity.description: Got duplicates? Turn them into dust or trade them with other players to complete your collection faster. The real challenge isn't collecting icons... it's collecting the right ones.

standard.name: Standard
standard.description: The essential form. A clean base where every detail counts.

holographic.name: Holographic
holographic.description: Subtle shimmer that shifts with the light. A more vivid presence.

brilliant.name: Brilliant
brilliant.description: Rare intensity. Animation, shine, and depth for an unforgettable reveal.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Create a small team, compare, and progress together. Gachapon isn't just a solo experience — it's a space for exchange, strategy, and observation.

collection.title: A living collection
collection.description: Build it over time, complete full sets. Missing pieces stay visible, waiting — a reminder of what's left to achieve.

identity.title: A visible identity
identity.description: Every profile is a signature. Visible collections, rare pieces on display, measurable progress. You're not just collecting icons — you're building a presence.

explainer.title: A collection game inspired by Japanese capsule toys.

intro.rest: is a free trading card game, playable directly in your browser. Inspired by the capsule vending machines ("gashapon") popular in Japan, it brings the mechanics of random draws into a digital experience: you get tokens every day, use them to open a capsule, and discover what's inside — a common, uncommon, rare, epic, or legendary card.

dust.before: The more you play, the more your collection grows. Duplicates turn into
dust.middle: , a secondary resource that lets you buy specific cards from the daily shop, upgrade your skill tree, or convert certain variants. The
dust.after: system guarantees that no unlucky streak lasts forever: the longer you go without pulling a rare card, the more the next pull guarantees a rarity tier.

variants.after: — each with its own reveal effect. Holographic and brilliant cards are only available from higher rarities, making them the most sought-after pieces in any collection.

explainer.outro: Gachapon is also built to be played with others: you can join a team, compare your progress, and access a public API as well as a Discord bot to track your pulls from outside the site. Access is instant, with nothing to download, and completely free.

footer.tagline: Catch. Collect. Trade. An elegant, immersive, and social experience.
